parsed.why: Statewide public-accommodation protections and a functioning commission plus sanctuary-city shield reduce local exposure; national passport/federal facility risks still cap it high.
Birth-sex facilities, shelter/prison placement, criminalized expression, and tolerated violence give tier-1 exposure with poor recourse.
Airport-wide birth-sex facilities plus private bounty lawsuits and invalid ID rules create continuous, state-enabled traveler exposure.
No statewide adult facility ban; partial city protections help, but statewide nondiscrimination and hate-crime gaps leave visitors exposed outside cities.
Campus facility bans, prison-care freezes, and absent protections worsen the baseline, though no adult public-building bounty applies.
